strength_relation_spot_check.claim_in_artifact: variant SET (set-based visibility) is strictly stronger than parent AF-WCC-VAC-GEN (single-q tail visibility)
strength_relation_spot_check.reason: J^-(I+) = union over q in I+ of J^-(q) is past-closed. If a tail gamma([t0,T)) lies in J^-(q0) for one q0, then every earlier point of the causal geodesic is in the causal past of a point of that tail, hence also in J^-(q0) and in J^-(I+). Therefore tail-visibility implies whole-geodesic containment in J^-(I+), i.e. the set of SET-visible geodesics contains the parent-visible set and the SET censorship conclusion is the stronger one. The artifact's stated one-way implication is valid as written; no finding.
